thought: The Slack post message action failed because the params were not set. I need to set the required parameters including select, channelId, messageType, and text with correct expression to extract text from input data.
plan: Set params for the Slack message post action with select as 'channel'.
Set channelId mode as 'name' and value as 'general' to send messages to #general channel.
Set messageType as 'text' and text param as '={{$json["text"]}}' to extract message text from input data.
Test the Slack action to ensure messages are sent successfully.
criticism: Currently, the Slack action params are empty, causing the workflow to fail on sending messages.

tool_input.comments: Set Slack message post action params to send text messages to #general channel.
